title: Pitch Template
description: Abstract sequence template — defines the STRUCTURE (steps, timing, intent per step, preferred angles) but not the per-contact CONTENT. Templates are reusable across talents + contacts. The AI generation step fills in subject + body per contact at send time, drawing from `data/pitch_angles.json`. See `docs/outreach_workflow.md`. Default templates ship at `data/pitch_templates/` (kept in repo for version-control of the playbook; per-agency customizations gitignored).

target_decision_role.description: Which contact decision_role this template is designed for. The orchestrator routes contacts to templates automatically based on this field. `unknown` contacts default to the buyer template.

success_criteria.description: Targets for this template's performance. Used in the UI to show whether the template is meeting its goal.

guardrails.description: Hard rules the AI generation must respect across all steps of this template. Step 1 manual-approval is enforced system-wide and is NOT configurable here — see `docs/outreach_workflow.md` § Review-before-send queue.

tone.description: Overall tone signal passed to the LLM. Tuned per template (buyer = direct_professional; champion = warm_casual; gatekeeper = brief_courteous).

intent.description: What this step is for. The LLM generation prompt is shaped by intent — e.g. `first_touch_strongest_angle` picks the highest-strength applicable angle; `break_up_door_open` is brief and leaves the door open without new asks.

timing_offset_days.description: Days after the PREVIOUS step (or after enrollment for step 1). Step 1 should be 0 (sent immediately). Typical cadence: 0, 3, 7, 14.

channel.description: Send channel for this step. v0.1 supports **email only**. LinkedIn outreach (`linkedin_message`, `linkedin_inmail`, `linkedin_connection`) is deferred to v2 — these values will be re-added to the enum when LinkedIn-send integration ships. Templates authored today must use `email` for every step.

preferred_angle_categories.description: Categories the LLM should prefer when picking the angle for this step. Empty array = no preference (LLM picks freely from all applicable).

excluded_angle_categories.description: Categories the LLM must NOT pick for this step (typically used to force variation across steps — e.g. step 2 excludes whatever step 1 used).

ai_model_override.description: Override default model. Defaults: step 1 = Sonnet (highest-value content); steps 2+ = Haiku (cost optimisation). Use Opus only for ultra-high-value pitches (e.g. premium-tier brands).

ai_prompt_overrides.description: Per-step prompt hints layered on top of the default per-intent prompt. Useful for talent-specific tone overrides without forking the template.

branching.description: Conditional logic that may skip this step or redirect to a different step based on previous-step engagement.

skip_if_prior_step_opened.description: If the previous step was opened but not replied to, skip this follow-up (gives them more time).

skip_if_prior_step_clicked.description: If they clicked a link, skip this follow-up (high engagement; wait for reply).

jump_to_step_on_engagement_threshold.description: If cumulative engagement exceeds threshold, jump forward to a closing step.
